summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the new 4-tab StumbleChat (People / Random Chat / Chats / Profile). All 17 backend pytest cases pass (profile CRUD, active-users + interests filter, Socket.IO register_user with interests, 2-user match, existing endpoints regression). Full frontend E2E executed: AuthOnboarding renders correctly with Stumble Chat brand + Google/Email/Guest + Privacy First panel; email OTP login + 18+ modal accepted; new tabbed SPA layout visible with all required data-testids; profile save persists to backend; People-tab interests filter toggle issues GET /api/active-users?interests=music,gaming; settings navigation works; ZERO non-WebSocket console errors.

issues: Live/Connecting badge stays 'CONNECTING' in preview because WSS upgrade returns 403 from ingress (polling works). Not a code bug, but UX-misleading. Consider treating successful socket.io polling connection as 'Live' too.

data-testid='logout-button' is conditional on isAuthenticated; under email-auth the pill 'User9919' renders but the logout button was not rendered during the test session. If logout via header is required for authenticated users, verify the isAuthenticated flag flow.

Custom div checkbox and the 'I Understand — Let's Chat' button have NO data-testid attributes. This blocks reliable automated testing of the gate. Add data-testid='age-agree-checkbox' and data-testid='age-confirm-btn'.

Interested-in pill labels use 'Anyone / Men / Women / Everyone'. The review request mentions API values 'male/female/both/empty' — labels do not map cleanly to those backend values (e.g. 'Everyone' vs 'both'). Confirm intended mapping; current 'Both'-keyword search misses because no such pill exists.

action_items: Add data-testid to the 18+ checkbox and confirm button in OnboardingModal.js (currently no testid → automated testing must rely on CSS class).
Decide labels vs backend values for interested-in pills (UI labels 'Anyone/Men/Women/Everyone' vs backend enums 'male/female/both/empty'). Verify mapping in ProfileTab handler.
Header 'Connecting' badge stays even when socket.io polling is connected — consider relaxing the 'Live' criterion to socket-connected (any transport), since wss is blocked in preview.
critical_code_review_comments: ProfileTab payload sends 'name' as a top-level field on PUT /api/profile/me — backend currently does not appear to persist the name (verified by GET returning unchanged user object). If name editing is intended, server PUT handler must also update the user.name.
Backend trims interests but does not deduplicate. Sending ['music','MUSIC','music '] stores ['music','music','music']. Consider dedup after lowercase+strip.
Frontend stores session_token in sessionStorage but localStorage in 'user' — multiple AuthContext fallbacks (legacy localStorage session_token) suggest dead code; remove migration once stable.
WebSocket 403 in preview ingress means real-time matching always uses long-polling fallback. Verify production ingress allows wss for /api/socket.io to avoid extra latency.
test_credentials: Email OTP — any email; dev_code returned by POST /api/auth/email/send-otp. Admin: x-admin-token=stumblechat_admin_2026
seed_data_creation: None persistent — each test created a TEST_ prefixed user via OTP; backend has no /api/users DELETE so users remain (acceptable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the dev_code-via-toast pattern: send-otp via UI then regex 'OTP sent.*?(\d{6})' from document.body.innerText. 18+ modal checkbox must be clicked via 'div.w-5.h-5.rounded.cursor-pointer' (no testid). Interested-in pill 'Both' does not exist — UI uses 'Everyone'. WS transport is blocked in preview (returns 403); rely on polling. Backend tests file path: /app/backend/tests/test_profile_and_users.py and test_socket_interests.py.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs requiring RCA — all flows green. Minor observations captured under design_issues and critical_code_review_comments.
